plans.idea: Faithful left-to-right banner like the original: a much larger logo-blocks hero on the left, headline with subheadline tight beneath it in the middle, and the CTA pill on the right, all centred on one horizontal axis and held off the canvas edges.
Centred vertical stack on a single axis: hero blocks on top as a brand mark, headline and subheadline grouped in the middle, CTA centred below, so the reading order runs brand → message → action.

Text-led split: a large left-aligned headline and subheadline take the left 55%, and a right column stacks the hero blocks over a centred CTA, so the message dominates and the visual and action sit together.
